formatted_question:
According to the paper "Group Sequence Policy Optimization", the likelihood of a response $y$ to a query $x$ under the policy $\pi_\theta$ is denoted, using the token-level autoregressive factorization over the tokens in $y$, by
(A) $\pi_\theta (y \mid x)=\frac{\exp s_\theta(x,y)}{\sum_{y'} \exp s_\theta(x,y')}$
(B) $\pi_\theta (y \mid x)=\prod_{t=1}^{|y|} \pi_\theta (y_t \mid x)$
(C) $\pi_\theta (y \mid x)=\sum_{t=1}^{|y|} \pi_\theta (y_t \mid x, y_{<t})$
(D) $\pi_\theta (y \mid x)=\prod_{t=1}^{|y|} \frac{\pi_\theta (y_t \mid x, y_{<t})}{\pi_{\theta_{\mathrm{old}}}(y_t \mid x, y_{<t})}$
(E) $\pi_\theta (y | x)=\prod_{t=1}^{|y|} \pi_\theta (y_t | x, y_{<t} )$
